mechanism: Atorvastatin may reduce cholecalciferol absorption through inhibition of intestinal cholesterol absorption pathways, and statins can impair vitamin D synthesis; cholecalciferol may enhance statin efficacy in reducing cardiovascular risk.
action: Monitor vitamin D levels periodically; supplementation with cholecalciferol is generally safe and may be beneficial for cardiovascular and bone health in patients on atorvastatin.
